title: CaptureManifest
description: CONTRACT 5 — Dexter's device -> Ryan's ingest path. FROZEN.

captured_at.description: GPS-derived UTC where a fix exists at capture time; best-effort device clock otherwise.

capture_mono_ns.description: Required (not optional, unlike the frame envelope) — the manifest is device-authored, so the boot-relative clock always exists at capture time.

x-notes: spool_seq is DEFERRED, not forgotten — it depends on an unanswered question about whether inference is deferred to a laptop, so it is deliberately absent from this schema rather than guessed at. The device spool itself is SQLite/WAL + tus resumable upload, not Redis, so this manifest is not a FrameEnvelope and is not published on the frames stream directly by the device.
